BENGALURU IN CONNECTION OF C.C.NO.2138/2021 ON THE FILE OF THE VI ACMM, BENGALURU FOR AN ALLEGED OFFENCE PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 323, 498A AND 506 OF IPC AND SECTIONS 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT, AGAINST THE PETITIONERS BY ALLOWING THE PETITION.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R. NATARAJ  ORAL ORDER

The petitioner has challenged the charge sheet filed by the respondent No.1 in C.C.No.2138/2021 pending on the file of the VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru NC:
2026:KHC:13386 HC-KAR for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: Sri Sathish Naidu vs State By Mahila Police Station
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners contended that a petition for dissolution of marriage was filed by respondent No.2 in M.C.No.5128/2021 before the V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru and that the same was amicably settled before the Mediation Center, Bengaluru and a settlement agreement was drawn up in terms of which, the parties have admitted that they have no further claims of whatsoever nature against each other.

entities.text: V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He therefore, contends that the respondent No.2 was bound to withdraw the impugned proceedings.
Since the same is not done, the petitioner is advised to file this petition.
3. The respondent No.2 though served with the notice has not appeared.

4. The Memorandum of Settlement filed before the V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court,
Bengaluru in M.C.No.5128/2021 states that the respondent No.2 has agreed to withdraw Crl.Misc.No.270/2021 pending before the IV Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru.

entities.text: IV Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It also NC: 2026:KHC:13386 HC-KAR states that there are no cases pending between the parties before any Court or authority.
Therefore, the fact of pendency of C.C.No.2138/2021 on the file of the VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, was not brought to the notice of the Court at the time of settlement.

entities.text: VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Since the parties have settled the dispute amicably, no purpose would be served in keeping the criminal proceedings against the petitioners alive.
5. Consequently, this petition is allowed.

The prosecution of the petitioners in C.C.No.2138/2021 on the file of VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, is quashed.

Sd/-
(R. NATARAJ) JUDGE PMR List No.: 1 Sl No.: 37 Sri Sathish Naidu vs State By Mahila Police Station on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83671439/
